name: 44864 · Perrysville, OH
findings: ZIP 44864 (Perrysville) has 22 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44864 (Perrysville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
71% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
